question: Can you work with Epic EHR data?
answer: Yes. In a hospital network project from our team’s experience, we brought Epic EHR data, operational files and demographic data into one governed lakehouse. [Read the case study](/case-studies/hospital-network-governed-lakehouse/).

question: How do you protect patient data?
answer: In the hospital network project from our team’s experience, access controls were designed around healthcare regulations from day one. In another hospital, records were de-identified before analysis. The platform runs in your own environment, and you own everything we build.

question: Can data help us plan for seasonal surges?
answer: Yes. In one hospital, a forecasting model trained on several years of admissions history helps plan beds and staff before seasonal surges. [Read the case study](/case-studies/hospital-seasonal-surge-forecasting/).

question: Where should a hospital start?
answer: With a [Data & AI Readiness Review](/readiness-review/). In about 10 working days you get a written plan for your data, and you decide if we’re the right fit.
